semantics.line: Independent signed line points, even with flat/missing money. Rising totals favor Over; improving a team's handicap favors that team.
semantics.money: Recent ordered share changes, no opening-to-current direction clamp.
semantics.divergence: Growing money against declining ticket share strengthens that money-side interpretation.
semantics.ticket_only: Observed flat money plus growing tickets weakens relative money backing for that side; this contrarian interpretation is a declared research prior.
semantics.degree: Line points and ten-percentage-point split changes enter continuously before the declared floor/caps.
semantics.reversals: Recent intervals can supersede the opening-to-current direction, including histories ending at their opening money share.
semantics.timing: Independent price evidence; separate same-window and later-price-confirming-earlier-money channels.
semantics.updates: Recompute from unadjusted baseline on each paired snapshot; never compound a previous full correction.
semantics.persistence: Unchanged shares preserve the split evidence until a new split change arrives; price-only moves remain independent and cannot change the split clock.

sizing.calibration: Select a declared profile separately by market using earlier-date net units; require 150 earlier games and 20 earlier qualifying bets, otherwise balanced. Conservative declared-order ties. No new presets or thresholds after viewing this screen.
sizing.note: The floor, caps, profiles and timing windows are design priors, not established optimal weights or true betting edges.

evaluation.source: Restored saved original market-study inputs and paired histories, with independently verified finals.
evaluation.training: Earlier ET dates; additional six-hour post-tipoff outcome availability proxy; cutoff uses earliest evaluated update that date.
evaluation.scope: Compare every fixed profile and chronological profile selection. No official record writes.

correctness_fix_after_initial_screen: Advance split recency only on an observed share change so flat-share, price-only updates cannot fade existing split evidence. This is a behavior fix; no weights, caps, floor or profile search changed after viewing returns.
